headline: Actress Azmeri Haque Badhan physically assaulted in Italy during film festival visit
summary: Returning to Dhaka, the actress alleged she was targeted by expatriates for her role in the July-August mass uprising.
details: Actress Azmeri Haque Badhan returned to Bangladesh this morning after alleging she was physically assaulted and harassed in Italy during her visit for the Venice International Film Festival.

Speaking at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, Badhan stated that the attackers laid hands on her in a local park, calling the brutality unacceptable and claiming it tarnished Bangladesh's image abroad.
She alleged that she was targeted due to her active role in the July-August 2024 student-led mass uprising, identifying the attackers as supporters of the banned Awami League and Chhatra League.
Badhan urged Awami League supporters not to become 'blind followers,' warning that while leaders abroad live comfortably, the followers' families will suffer the consequences of such actions.
She further called on the party leadership to reconsider their future political roadmap to avoid creating a path they would be ashamed of in the future.
In a separate bombshell, Badhan claimed that while director Rubaiyat Hossain supported her, some members of her own team had 'disowned' her following the incident.
She also mentioned being dropped from the Toronto International Film Festival, though she did not elaborate on the specific circumstances of that decision.
caption:
Physically assaulted in Italy and 'disowned' by her own team. Actress Azmeri Haque Badhan returns to Dhaka with a bombshell.

Actress Azmeri Haque Badhan returned to Bangladesh this morning after alleging she was physically assaulted and harassed in Italy during her visit for the Venice International Film Festival.

Speaking at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, Badhan stated that the attackers laid hands on her in a local park, calling the brutality unacceptable and claiming it tarnished Bangladesh's image abroad.

She alleged that she was targeted due to her active role in the July-August 2024 student-led mass uprising, identifying the attackers as supporters of the banned Awami League and Chhatra League.

Badhan urged Awami League supporters not to become 'blind followers,' warning that while leaders abroad live comfortably, the followers' families will suffer the consequences of such actions.

She further called on the party leadership to reconsider their future political roadmap to avoid creating a path they would be ashamed of in the future.

In a separate bombshell, Badhan claimed that while director Rubaiyat Hossain supported her, some members of her own team had 'disowned' her following the incident.

She also mentioned being dropped from the Toronto International Film Festival, though she did not elaborate on the specific circumstances of that decision.

headline_marked: 7-year-old girl [[raped and killed by daughter's father]], body buried in floor
headline: 7-year-old girl raped and killed by daughter's father, body buried in floor
summary: A first-grade student was murdered by a neighbor in Jamalpur after visiting his home to find her classmate. The suspect has been arrested.
details: A seven-year-old girl, a first-grade student at a local government primary school, was raped and murdered by the father of her classmate in Madarganj, Jamalpur.
According to Assistant Superintendent of Police Mostafizur Rahman, the suspect, Jaminur Islam (32), confessed in court to the crime during a press conference on Monday.

The child had gone to Jaminur's house last Thursday to look for her classmate. While Jaminur's wife and children were away, he took advantage of the situation to rape and strangle the girl with a scarf.
To hide the crime, the suspect dug a hole in the floor of his own room and buried the child's body there.
The girl had been missing since Thursday morning after going to school. Her body was recovered from the floor of Jaminur's house on Saturday night.
Police arrested Jaminur and his wife, Sabuza (25), on Saturday night. Both have been sent to jail following a court appearance.
The victim's father has filed a formal case with the police. The child's uncle has called for exemplary punishment for the perpetrator.
